topic: Function Definition and Call from Within Functions
explanation: Functions are fundamental building blocks in C programming. They encapsulate a block of code that performs a specific task.  This promotes modularity, reusability, and code organization. Functions are defined separately and then called (or invoked) from other parts of the program, including from within other functions. This allows for breaking down complex problems into smaller, manageable pieces.
book: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie
